interface.signature: def prefixSuffixString(s1: List[str], s2: List[str]) -> int:

preconditions.description: Both s1 and s2 are lists.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, str) for x in s1) and all(isinstance(x, str) for x in s2)
preconditions.description: All elements in s1 and s2 are strings.
The lengths of s1 and s2 are between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(5 <= len(x) < 25 for x in s1) and all(5 <= len(x) < 25 for x in s2)
preconditions.description: The length of every string in s1 and s2 is between 5 and 24 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for t in s2 if any((t == s[:len(t)] or t == s[-len(t):]) for s in s1))
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of strings in s2 that are either a prefix or a suffix of at least one string in s1.
